fields.name: MemberId
fields.about: The member id generated by the consumer. The member id must be kept during the entire lifetime of the consumer process.

fields.name: MemberEpoch
fields.about: The current member epoch; 0 to join the group; -1 to leave the group; -2 to indicate that the static member will rejoin.

fields.name: InstanceId
fields.about: null if not provided or if it didn't change since the last heartbeat; the instance Id otherwise.

fields.name: RackId
fields.about: null if not provided or if it didn't change since the last heartbeat; the rack ID of consumer otherwise.

fields.name: RebalanceTimeoutMs
fields.about: -1 if it didn't change since the last heartbeat; the maximum time in milliseconds that the coordinator will wait on the member to revoke its partitions otherwise.

fields.name: SubscribedTopicNames
fields.about: null if it didn't change since the last heartbeat; the subscribed topic names otherwise.

fields.name: SubscribedTopicRegex
fields.about: null if it didn't change since the last heartbeat; the subscribed topic regex otherwise.

fields.name: ServerAssignor
fields.about: null if not used or if it didn't change since the last heartbeat; the server side assignor to use otherwise.

fields.name: TopicPartitions
fields.about: null if it didn't change since the last heartbeat; the partitions owned by the member.
